originalTitle: Anthropic Stock Slips After-Hours as Blockbuster IPO Does Little for AI Names: OpenAI-Backer SoftBank Crashes in Nikkei Meltdown

content:
Anthropic PBC (NASDAQ:ANT) shares traded well above their IPO price on Thursday's Nasdaq debut but slipped after hours, and the much-anticipated listing did little to lift the artificial intelligence trade.

In Asia on Friday, shares of Japan's SoftBank Group (OTC:SFTBY) (OTC:SFTBF) , a major backer of Anthropic's rival OpenAI , fell 14.67% as technology stocks sold off.

Dow futures fell 93 points, or 0.19%, to 49,087.00, while S&P 500 futures declined 20 points, or 0.28%, to 7,177.25. Nasdaq 100 futures fell 159.50 points, or 0.60%, to 26,440.75 as of around 7:38 p.m. EST.

In commodities, WTI crude oil for December deliveries fell 0.53% to $83.65 per barrel, while Brent crude for January deliveries was unchanged at $91.98 per barrel. Natural gas futures fell 0.67% to $3.246 per MMBtu.

Meanwhile, the U.S. dollar index, which tracks the greenback against a basket of currencies, stood at 103.867, up 0.03% at the time of writing.

Asian markets traded lower, with South Korea's KOSPI down 4.04% to 4,930.40 and Japan's Nikkei 225 down 4.69% to 56,654.72.

According to market commentator Bull Theory, Japanese stocks lost more than JPY 53 trillion ($332.55 billion).

🚨BLOODBATH IN JAPANESE MARKETS Over ¥53,000,000,000,000 ($337B) wiped out from Japanese stocks as the NIKKEI crashes -4.5% to its lowest level in seven months. pic.twitter.com/Viedep8cDN

— Bull Theory (@BullTheoryio) November 20, 2026

Anthropic opened at $111.50 per share , 34% above its $83 IPO price, and peaked near $115 before drifting lower. The stock still closed 17.07% above its IPO price and fell 4.70% in extended trading.

The company priced the offering Wednesday night above its marketed range of $70 to $78, valuing it at about $1.5 trillion. It raised $81.3 billion, the largest IPO on record.

About 832 million shares changed hands, more than in the first session of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (NASDAQ:SPCX) , and Anthropic was the most actively traded stock on the Nasdaq, according to CNBC.

Analysts Point to Funding Pressure, Crowded Positioning

Economist Mohamed El-Erian said in a post on X that the drop in the Nasdaq and other U.S. indexes, alongside Anthropic's gains, is "not just about the promise of AI, but about making room for it."

He said investors are selling other holdings to make room for the IPO.

For those surprised that the NASDAQ and other US stock market indices are down 1.5–2% (CNBC data below) while Anthropic is trading 20% above its IPO price, remember this isn't just about the promise of AI, but about making room for it. In a narrow sense, investor financing of the… pic.twitter.com/oG2kLbB543

— Mohamed A. El-Erian (@elerianm) November 19, 2026

Gene Munster of Deepwater Asset Management said that many had bet the IPO would lift the broader AI trade, calling it "classic groupthink."

He said the action does not indict AI but reflects "what happens when many were on the same side of the trade," and that the roughly $80 billion Anthropic raised will fund infrastructure and applications.

NASDAQ drops 2% as $ANT pops 20%. Many were betting the Anthropic IPO would lift the broader AI trade. Classic groupthink. My take: Today's action isn't an indictment of AI. It's what happens when many were on the same side of the trade. Investors still want the exposure, and…

— Gene Munster (@munster_gene) November 19, 2026

Price Action: Anthropic's shares closed 17.07% higher at $97.17 on its debut and fell 4.70% to $92.60 in extended trading.

Benzinga Edge rankings indicate Anthropic's stock has a negative price trend across the short, medium, and long term.

chineseTitle: Anthropic 股票盘后下跌，因为重磅 IPO 对 AI 名称影响不大：OpenAI 支持者软银在日经指数崩盘中崩盘
chineseSummary: Anthropic PBC（纳斯达克股票代码：ANT）的股价周四在纳斯达克上市时的交易价格远高于首次公开募股价格，但盘后下跌，而备受期待的上市并没有提振人工智能交易。周五在亚洲，随着科技股遭到抛售，Anthropic 竞争对手 OpenAI 的主要支持者日本软银集团 (OTC:SFTBY) (OTC:SFTBF) 股价下跌 14.67%。盘后期货下跌 道指期货下跌 93 点，或 0.19%，至 49,087.00，标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌 20 点，或 0.28
chineseContent:
Anthropic PBC（纳斯达克股票代码：ANT）周四在纳斯达克上市，其股价远高于首次公开募股价格，但盘后下跌，而备受期待的上市对人工智能交易几乎没有提振。

周五在亚洲，由于科技股遭到抛售，Anthropic 竞争对手 OpenAI 的主要支持者日本软银集团 (OTC:SFTBY) (OTC:SFTBF) 的股价下跌 14.67%。

道琼斯指数期货下跌 93 点，或 0.19%，至 49,087.00 点；标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌 20 点，或 0.28%，至 7,177.25 点。截至晚上7点38分左右，纳斯达克100指数期货下跌159.50点，跌幅0.60%，至26,440.75点。美国东部时间。

大宗商品方面，12 月交割的 WTI 原油下跌 0.53%，至每桶 83.65 美元，而 1 月交割的布伦特原油持平，为每桶 91.98 美元。天然气期货下跌 0.67%，至每 MMBtu 3.246 美元。

与此同时，追踪美元兑一篮子货币的美元指数报103.867，截至发稿时上涨0.03%。

亚洲市场走低，韩国综合股价指数下跌 4.04%，至 4,930.40 点；日本日经 225 指数下跌 4.69%，至 56,654.72 点。

据市场评论员 Bull Theory 称，日本股市损失超过 53 万亿日元（3,325.5 亿美元）。

🚨日本市场血洗日本股市损失超过 53,000,000,000,000 日元（$337B），日经指数暴跌 -4.5% 至七个月以来的最低水平。 pic.twitter.com/Viedep8cDN

— 牛市理论 (@BullTheoryio) 2026 年 11 月 20 日

Anthropic 开盘价为每股 111.50 美元，较其 83 美元的 IPO 价格高出 34%，最高点接近 115 美元，然后一路走低。该股收盘仍较发行价高出 17.07%，盘后交易中下跌 4.70%。

该公司周三晚上的发行定价高于 70 至 78 美元的市场区间，估值约为 1.5 万亿美元。它筹集了 813 亿美元，是有记录以来最大的 IPO。

据 CNBC 报道，大约 8.32 亿股易手，比 Space Exploration Technologies Corp.（纳斯达克股票代码：SPCX）第一交易日的交易量还要多，Anthropic 是纳斯达克交易最活跃的股票。

分析师指出资金压力、仓位拥挤

经济学家 Mohamed El-Erian 在 X 上的一篇文章中表示，纳斯达克和其他美国指数的下跌以及 Anthropic 的上涨“不仅与人工智能的前景有关，而且还为其腾出了空间。”

他表示，投资者正在出售其他持股，为首次公开募股腾出空间。

对于那些对纳斯达克和其他美国股市指数下跌 1.5-2%（CNBC 数据如下）而 Anthropic 的交易价格比 IPO 价格高出 20% 感到惊讶的人来说，请记住，这不仅仅是人工智能的承诺，而是为其腾出空间。从狭义上讲，投资者融资...... pic.twitter.com/oG2kLbB543

— Mohamed A. El-Erian (@elerianm) 2026 年 11 月 19 日

Deepwater Asset Management 的吉恩·蒙斯特 (Gene Munster) 表示，许多人押注 IPO 将提振更广泛的人工智能行业，称其为“经典的群体思维”。

他表示，这一行动并不起诉人工智能，而是反映了“当许多人站在交易的同一方时会发生什么”，并且 Anthropic 筹集的约 800 亿美元将用于资助基础设施和应用程序。

纳斯达克指数下跌 2%，而 $ANT 则上涨 20%。许多人押注 Anthropic 的 IPO 将提振更广泛的人工智能行业。经典的群体思维。我的看法：今天的行动并不是对人工智能的控诉。当许多人都站在交易的同一方时就会发生这种情况。投资者仍然希望获得曝光，并且……

— 吉恩·蒙斯特 (@munster_gene) 2026 年 11 月 19 日

价格走势：Anthropic 股价首次亮相时收盘上涨 17.07%，至 97.17 美元，在盘后交易中下跌 4.70%，至 92.60 美元。

Benzinga Edge 排名表明 Anthropic 的股票在短期、中期和长期内都有负面的价格趋势。
